findings.title: Concurrent builds for the same namespace/resource are no longer serialized
findings.body: Moving the cache lock to only the final map assignment permits two callers that both observe a cache miss to build the same key concurrently. There is no per-key singleflight in `getOrCreateIndex`. For file-backed indexes, concurrent `bleve.New` calls target the same directory and one build can fail; for memory-backed indexes, whichever build finishes last overwrites the cache regardless of which snapshot is newer, potentially discarding indexed documents or writes incorporated by the other build. Retain keyed build coordination (and recheck the cache after acquiring it) while allowing unrelated keys to build concurrently.

findings.title: Bleve build span context is still not propagated to the index builder
findings.body: `BuildIndex` starts a span but discards the returned context. The supplied `builder` callback performs the list/index work using the caller's context, so that work is not a descendant of `unified_search.bleve.BuildIndex`. This leaves the trace propagation fix incomplete for the Bleve build path; assign the returned context and invoke downstream work with it.

findings.title: The storage-server integration test is disabled for all PostgreSQL runs
findings.body: This change unconditionally skips the test whenever `GRAFANA_TEST_DB=postgres`, including CI environments. PostgreSQL is a supported non-SQLite storage-server backend, so the startup behavior changed by this PR will no longer have integration coverage there. Fix the test/environment issue rather than permanently skipping that backend.
